Around the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a '''scavenger''' competed with [[Tharan Cedrax]] in order to buy a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] program named [[Holiday (hologram)|Holiday]] which the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Glorzo]] had decided to sell. Glorzo then issued a contest for the two, where the first to acquire a stone in the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Rukabi Major]] and bring it back to the Hutt would win Holiday. Eventually, Tharan Cedrax triumphed over the [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] on this contest and received Holiday.
